```{r}


#### i want a method that incorporates the surivival data
# ── 0. Prep data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
prob_mat     <- as.matrix(merged_df[, leiden_cols])
zero_frac    <- colMeans(prob_mat == 0)
leiden_cols_filtered <- names(zero_frac[zero_frac <= 0.9999])

rsf_data <- merged_df[, c("dfs_months", "dfs_event", leiden_cols_filtered)]

## see what was removed
 

cat("NAs in rsf_data after imputation:", sum(is.na(rsf_data)), "\n")
cat("NaNs in rsf_data after imputation:", 
    sum(sapply(rsf_data, function(x) sum(is.nan(x)))), "\n")

# ── Find exactly where the 9 NAs are ─────────────────────────────────────────
na_locations <- which(is.na(rsf_data), arr.ind = TRUE)
print(na_locations)  # shows row and column of each NA

# Which columns have NAs?
na_cols <- colnames(rsf_data)[unique(na_locations[, "col"])]
cat("Columns with NAs:", na_cols, "\n")

# Which rows?
na_rows <- unique(na_locations[, "row"])
cat("Rows with NAs:", na_rows, "\n")

# ── 1. Fit RSF ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
rsf_fit <- rfsrc(
  Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ .,
  data       = rsf_data,
  ntree      = 1000,
  importance = TRUE,
  ntime      = 100,
  seed       = 42
)

print(rsf_fit)  # OOB C-index — >0.6 is reasonable, >0.7 is good

# ── 2. Variable importance ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
vimp <- sort(rsf_fit$importance, decreasing = TRUE)
par(mar = c(4, 10, 3, 1))
barplot(rev(vimp[1:15]),
        horiz   = TRUE,
        las     = 1,
        col     = "steelblue",
        main    = "RSF Variable Importance: Top 15 Leiden Cell Types",
        xlab    = "VIMP")

# ── 3. Minimal depth (interaction structure) ──────────────────────────────────
md_obj <- max.subtree(rsf_fit)
print(md_obj$order[1:15, ])  # lower depth = stronger role in interactions

# Minimal depth interaction matrix
md_obj <- max.subtree(rsf_fit, sub.order = TRUE)

# Print the interaction table (lower value = stronger interaction)
print(round(md_obj$sub.order, 2))

sub_order <- md_obj$sub.order
sub_df <- melt(sub_order)
colnames(sub_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "MinDepth")

ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = MinDepth)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "white",
                      name = "Min Depth\n(lower = stronger)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Leiden Cell Type Pairwise Interactions (Minimal Depth)",
       x = "", y = "")

###no interactions interestingly
# ── Rebuild rsf_data: drop only on dfs NAs ────────────────────────────────────
survival_complete <- !is.na(merged_df$dfs_months) & !is.na(merged_df$dfs_event)
rsf_data <- merged_df[survival_complete, c("dfs_months", "dfs_event", leiden_cols_filtered)]

# Verify
cat("rsf_data rows:", nrow(rsf_data), "\n")  # should now be 267
cat("rsf_fit n:    ", rsf_fit$n, "\n")       # 267 — must match
#Build survival_df with risk score
survival_df          <- rsf_data
survival_df$rsf_risk <- predict(rsf_fit, newdata = rsf_data)$predicted

# ── Check what's actually in survival_df ─────────────────────────────────────
colnames(survival_df)  # is rsf_risk in there?
nrow(survival_df)      # should be 267

preds <- predict(rsf_fit, newdata = rsf_data)$predicted
survival_df <- as.data.frame(rsf_data)
survival_df$rsf_risk <- preds

cat("rsf_risk exists:", "rsf_risk" %in% colnames(survival_df), "\n")  # TRUE
# ── Now the histogram is ready to run ─────────────────────────────────────────
# ── Histogram of RSF risk score distribution ──────────────────────────────────
ggplot(survival_df, aes(x = rsf_risk)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, probs = c(1/3, 2/3)),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "orange", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, 1/3), 
           y = Inf, label = "Tertile 1", vjust = 2, hjust = 1.1, 
           colour = "orange", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, 2/3), 
           y = Inf, label = "Tertile 2", vjust = 2, hjust = 1.1, 
           colour = "orange", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, 0.5), 
           y = Inf, label = "Median", vjust = 4, hjust = -0.1, 
           colour = "red", size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "RSF Risk Score Distribution",
       subtitle = "Orange dashed = tertile cuts | Red dotted = quartile cuts",
       x = "RSF Predicted Risk Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# ── 5. Risk score + KM plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
merged_df$rsf_risk  <- predict(rsf_fit, newdata = rsf_data)$predicted
merged_df$risk_grp  <- ifelse(
  merged_df$rsf_risk > median(merged_df$rsf_risk), "High", "Low"
)

km_fit <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ risk_grp, data = merged_df)

ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data       = merged_df,
  pval       = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  xlab       = "Time (months)",
  ylab       = "Disease-Free Survival",
  title      = "DFS: RSF-derived Leiden Abundance Risk Groups",
  palette    = c("#E7298A", "#1B9E77"),
  legend.labs = c("High Risk", "Low Risk")
)


### se what it looks like surivival wise
# ── 3 groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
survival_df$risk_grp3 <- cut(
  survival_df$rsf_risk,
  breaks         = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1)),
  labels         = c("Low", "Mid", "High"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)
table(survival_df$risk_grp3)  # ~89 per group

# ── 4 groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
survival_df$risk_grp4 <- cut(
  survival_df$rsf_risk,
  breaks         = quantile(survival_df$rsf_risk, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)),
  labels         = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)


table(survival_df$risk_grp4) 


#km plots
km3 <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ risk_grp3, data = survival_df)
ggsurvplot(km3, data = survival_df, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
           palette     = c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#E7298A"),
           legend.labs = c("Low", "Mid", "High"),
           xlab        = "Time (months)",
           title       = "DFS: 3 Risk Groups")
km4 <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ risk_grp4, data = survival_df)

ggsurvplot(
  km4,
  data        = survival_df,
  pval        = TRUE,
  pval.method = TRUE,
  risk.table  = TRUE,
  conf.int    = FALSE,
  xlab        = "Time (months)",
  ylab        = "Disease-Free Survival Probability",
  title       = "DFS by RSF-Derived Risk Groups (Quartiles)",
  legend.title = "Risk Group",
  legend.labs = c("Q1 Low", "Q2 Mid-Low", "Q3 Mid-High", "Q4 High"),
  palette     = c("#1B9E77", "#7FC97F", "#D95F02", "#E7298A"),
  risk.table.height = 0.28,
  ggtheme     = theme_minimal()
)
```

```{r}
km3 <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ risk_grp3, data = survival_df)
print(summary(km3)$table[, c("records", "events", "median", "0.95LCL", "0.95UCL")])

cat("\n=== RESULTS: COX HR FOR CONTINUOUS RISK SCORE ===\n")
cox_cont <- coxph(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ rsf_risk, data = survival_df)
print(summary(cox_cont)$coefficients)
print(summary(cox_cont)$conf.int)

cat("\n=== END OF REPORTING OUTPUT ===\n")
```

```{r}
cent_long <- centroids %>%
  mutate(profile_group = paste0("Group", 1:2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = leiden_cols,
               names_to = "leiden_cluster",
               values_to = "mean_prob")

# Keep only clusters where at least one group has mean_prob > threshold
top_clusters <- cent_long %>%
  group_by(leiden_cluster) %>%
  summarise(max_prob = max(mean_prob)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_prob)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(leiden_cluster)

cent_long %>%
  filter(leiden_cluster %in% top_clusters) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = leiden_cluster, y = profile_group, fill = mean_prob)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_prob, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2E9FDF") +
  labs(title = "Top clusters by profile group",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Profile Group", fill = "Mean Prob") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

diff_df <- data.frame(
  leiden_cluster = leiden_cols,
  group1_prob    = as.numeric(centroids[1, ]),
  group2_prob    = as.numeric(centroids[2, ])
)

diff_df$difference <- abs(diff_df$group1_prob - diff_df$group2_prob)

# Top discriminating clusters
diff_df %>%
  arrange(desc(difference)) %>%
  head(15)
```

```{r}
# All event / no-event MCs must be columns in merged_df
stopifnot(all(mc_event_both    %in% colnames(merged_df)))
stopifnot(all(mc_no_event_both %in% colnames(merged_df)))
merged_df_scores <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    # summed abundance over bad (event) metaclusters
    bad_abund  = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_event_both)),    na.rm = TRUE),
    # summed abundance over good (no-event) metaclusters
    good_abund = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_no_event_both)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # raw score: higher = more bad vs good
    score_raw = bad_abund - good_abund
  )

ggplot(merged_df_scores, aes(x = score_raw)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Raw prognosis score (bad - good MC abundance)",
    y = "Number of patients"
  )
```

```{r}
# use the leiden abundance cols as predictors
leiden_cols_new <- colnames(merged_relapse)[grepl("abundance_metacluster_leiden", colnames(merged_relapse))]
X <- as.matrix(merged_relapse[, leiden_cols_new])
y <- merged_relapse$dfs_event

# LASSO logistic regression
fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, nfolds =5)

# plot cross-validation curve
plot(fit)

# coefficients at best lambda
coef(fit, s = "lambda.min")

# non-zero predictors only
coef_mat <- coef(fit, s = "lambda.min")
coef_mat[coef_mat[,1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]

# does MC_80 abundance perfectly separate relapse groups?
merged_relapse %>%
  select(dfs_event, abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80) %>%
  group_by(dfs_event) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80),
            sd   = sd(abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_80))
```
```{r}
# extract non-zero coefficients
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = rownames(coef_mat),
  coefficient = coef_mat[, 1]
) %>%
  filter(cluster != "(Intercept)", coefficient != 0)

# split into > 0 (associated with relapse) and < 0 (protective)
relapse_associated <- coef_df %>% filter(coefficient > 0) %>% arrange(desc(coefficient))
protective         <- coef_df %>% filter(coefficient < 0) %>% arrange(coefficient)

cat("=== Associated with RELAPSE (coef > 0) ===\n")
print(relapse_associated)

cat("\n=== PROTECTIVE against relapse (coef < 0) ===\n")
print(protective)
```

```{r}
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_52",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_0",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_8",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_35",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_13",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_7",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_11",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_12"
)

heatmap_data <- merged_relapse %>%
  filter(!is.na(dfs_event)) %>%
  group_by(dfs_event) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(lasso_clusters), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("dfs_event") %>%
  t()

rownames(heatmap_data) <- gsub("abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_", "", rownames(heatmap_data))
colnames(heatmap_data) <- c("No Relapse", "Relapse")

# remove zero variance rows
heatmap_data_clean <- heatmap_data[apply(heatmap_data, 1, sd) != 0, ]

pheatmap(heatmap_data_clean,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         main = "LASSO-selected Metacluster Abundance by Relapse Status",
         fontsize_row = 10)


mc_prob_stats_lasso <- map_dfr(lasso_clusters, function(col) {
  p <- merged_relapse[[col]]

  p_event   <- p[merged_relapse$dfs_event == 1]
  p_noevent <- p[merged_relapse$dfs_event == 0]

  p_event   <- p_event[!is.na(p_event)]
  p_noevent <- p_noevent[!is.na(p_noevent)]

  wt <- wilcox.test(p_event, p_noevent, exact = FALSE)

  tibble(
    metacluster         = gsub("abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_", "", col),
    mean_relapse        = mean(p_event),
    mean_no_relapse     = mean(p_noevent),
    p_value             = wt$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(adj_p_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

print(mc_prob_stats_lasso, n = Inf)
```
